baseline.note: Every recipe feeds JEV these shared evidence families identically in both arms and varies only its declared lever. An absent per-arm grant means the family default.

ha.note: Allowlisted Home Assistant device facts (per-arm key ha_evidence), duplicated to both arms from the same snapshots.

ambient.note: Code-computed clock, daylight and weather priors (per-arm source_policy.ambient); one block per offer tick for both arms.

caption.note: Historical Qwen caption enum (per-arm key caption_evidence); outside the baseline, granted only as a lever.

qwen_scene.note: Continuous structured Qwen scene facts and code-built history (per-arm source_policy.qwen_scene), one identical record per offer tick for both arms; coverage stays not_provisioned until the perceiver is configured and not_granted until the household policy lists lab-live-scene-1. Correlated with the camera, never independent, never refreshes freshness.

temporal_encoder.note: V-JEPA 2.1 den buckets (per-arm source_policy.temporal_encoder): uncalibrated posture, reading, zero-shot, motion and scene-change words from frozen probes run on LA over stored den preview clips, one identical record per offer tick for every granted arm. Outside the baseline, granted only as a lever (vjepa-onoff); coverage stays not_provisioned until the vjepa_live pump is configured and not_granted until the household policy lists vjepa-den-1. Correlated with the camera, calibration unvalidated, never independent, never refreshes freshness.

spatial.note: Validated shared spatial facts; per-arm localization and room_map remain pipeline settings.
